about_the_game:
Blend in. Strike fast. Outsmart everyone.
Step into Assassins Arena—a fast, chaotic, and laugh-out-loud multiplayer party game where deception is your greatest weapon. Hide among the crowd, pick your moment, and take down your targets without anyone noticing. No swords. No guns. Just pure wit, nerve, and quick thinking.

Dive into the ultimate test of stealth and social deception. Outsmart, outplay, and outlast your friends (or enemies) in a thrilling mind game like no other.

Features

🔍 Stealth-Based Party Gameplay
Master the art of hiding in plain sight. Blend with the NPCs, track your prey, and strike at the perfect moment without getting caught. If you slip up, your location is revealed—and everyone will be coming for you!

🎯 Four Exciting Game Modes
Choose your strategy and adapt your playstyle across a variety of intense modes:

  • Target Mode:
    All players are assigned the same secret NPC target.
    Find and subdue them first to claim victory—but beware: rushing or being too obvious will expose your intentions! You’ll need a sharp eye and perfect timing to succeed. It's a race against time... and against each other.

  • Elimination Mode:
    Everyone is both a hunter and the hunted.
    Blend in and observe carefully, because any wrong move can turn you into someone else's prey.
    Subdue other players one by one without revealing yourself. Play too aggressively, and you’ll be an easy target. Play too cautiously, and you’ll be eliminated before you even make a move. Only one player will survive.

  • Team Mode:
    Cooperation meets deception.
    Players are split into two teams. One team must protect a hidden NPC, ensuring they survive unnoticed, while the other team must hunt and subdue the target.
    Will you coordinate subtly and protect your VIP, or infiltrate enemy lines without revealing your true identity? Teamwork, misdirection, and bluffing are your best weapons.

  • Single Player Mode:
    Hone your stealth skills solo in an unforgiving challenge.
    Track down multiple NPC targets, one after another.
    One mistake—subduing the wrong NPC—and you instantly lose.
    It’s the perfect mode for training your observation skills, mastering the art of patience, and preparing yourself for the chaos of multiplayer battles.

🌎 Dynamic and Immersive Maps
Explore richly detailed maps where every corner, crowd, and object can help you hide—or expose you. Sneak through busy city streets, desolate pirate islands, dusty western towns, and more. Each map offers unique layouts and behaviors for NPCs, keeping the gameplay fresh and unpredictable.

👥 Online and Local Multiplayer
Play with 2–8 players online. Whether you want serious stealth battles or casual, laugh-filled party nights, Assassins Arena delivers endless replayability.

😂 Unforgettable Moments
Witness hilarious blunders, unexpected betrayals, last-second victories, and outrageous misplays. Every round is full of moments that will have you and your friends shouting, laughing, and plotting revenge.

Why Assassins Arena?

  • Stealth and social deduction merged into one thrilling party experience.

  • Quick, intense matches perfect for game nights and streamers.

  • Easy to learn, rewarding to master—no two matches are ever the same.

Will You Blend In or Stand Out?

In Assassins Arena, brains beat brawn.
Patience beats recklessness.
The best assassin is the one no one ever suspects.

Can you keep your cool, hide among the crowd, and strike when it matters most?
Step into the arena, deceive your rivals, and prove you're the ultimate master of stealth.

No weapons. No mercy. Just your mind.

short_description: Assassins Arena is a stealth-based multiplayer party game where you blend in with NPCs, subdue your targets, and deceive your opponents—without weapons! Outsmart others in fast-paced, action-packed matches, either single player or online with 2-8 players.
